hero.title: Cyber Luna
hero.subtitle: Premium 3D printing e-shop delivering custom cyberpunk aesthetics with automated fulfillment and proprietary CAD optimization.

overview.challenge_desc: Launching a niche cyberpunk aesthetic e-commerce platform with 3D-printed, NFC-enabled products. The market was ultra-niche collectors, and typical e-commerce platforms couldn't handle the complexity of digital asset delivery (3D files) + physical product (prints) + tech integration seamlessly.
overview.solution_desc: Built a custom Shopify integration with proprietary backend for NFC encryption and asset management. The stack combines Nuxt + Node.js API + Shopify GraphQL for seamless order processing.
